# Minimal Theme Settings 9.0.0 compatibility fixture

This fixture contains the unmodified official Minimal Theme Settings 9.0.0
release artifacts. It exercises the actual upstream declarative groups,
toggle/dropdown bindings, imperative slider render callbacks,
`setControlValue` super-call override, commands, config calls, persistence, and
body-class/CSS updates.

Source tag and release:

- Tag: `9.0.0`
- Release: https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-minimal-settings/releases/tag/9.0.0
- `main.js`: https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-minimal-settings/releases/download/9.0.0/main.js
- `manifest.json`: https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-minimal-settings/releases/download/9.0.0/manifest.json
- `styles.css`: https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-minimal-settings/releases/download/9.0.0/styles.css
- `LICENSE`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kepano/obsidian-minimal-settings/9.0.0/LICENSE

Identity was verified before adoption as
`obsidian-minimal-settings@9.0.0`, declaring `minAppVersion: 1.13.0`.
